**Interface** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package. Extends [IDisposable](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.idisposable).

```csharp
public interface IPrintSystem : IDisposable
```

A platform print system, such as the Windows spooler or CUPS, implemented by a Latiprimere platform adapter.

Applications normally use [IPrinterCatalog](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprintercatalog/), which combines every supported print system. Printer identifiers returned by a print system must not clash with those of other print systems.

Print systems may hold connections, such as the HTTP client of the CUPS and IPP print systems, so dispose them when finished. A dependency injection container does that for the print systems it creates; an application that creates them with a factory disposes them itself. Printers and jobs obtained from a print system stop working once it is disposed.

## Properties

### IsSupported

```csharp
bool IsSupported { get; }
```

Gets a value indicating whether the print system can be used on the current platform.

### Name

```csharp
string Name { get; }
```

Gets the name of the print system, used in diagnostics.

## Methods

### FindDefaultPrinterAsync

```csharp
Task<IPrinter?> FindDefaultPrinterAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Looks for this print system's default printer.

**Parameters**

- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the operation.

**Returns**

The default printer, or `null` if none is set.

**Exceptions**

- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The print system failed while looking up the default printer.

### FindPrinterAsync

```csharp
Task<IPrinter?> FindPrinterAsync(string printerId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Looks for a printer by its identifier.

**Parameters**

- `printerId`: The printer identifier.
- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the operation.

**Returns**

The printer, or `null` if this print system has no printer with that identifier.

**Exceptions**

- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The print system failed while looking up the printer.

### GetPrintersAsync

```csharp
Task<IReadOnlyList<PrinterInfo>> GetPrintersAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Gets information about every printer in this print system.

**Parameters**

- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the operation.

**Returns**

The printers. Empty if the print system has none.

**Exceptions**

- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The print system failed while listing printers.
